notes: TorchInu (src/TorchInu.sol) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 built on OpenZeppelin Contracts 5.4.0 ERC20. Its name() and symbol() both return TORCHINU and decimals() returns 18. The constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 TORCHINU (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which on this launch is the ProjectFactory; nothing can mint afterwards. The token has no owner, no mint, burn, burnFrom, pause, blacklist, freeze, seize, upgrade path or initializer, no fee, tax or burn on transfer, no receive or fallback, and its runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. Because every transfer moves exactly the requested amount, the token needs no exemptions and does not take the factory, pool manager or launch number as constructor arguments. There are no application contracts. The factory pays the supply out: the swarm's share to the launch's MerkleDistributor, 85% of the supply to seed the single-sided Uniswap v4 pool against IMD, and the remainder to economics.remainderTo. The pool opens at the chain's 1.25% launch fee with tick spacing 60; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei (2,500 IMD for the whole supply) and totalSupply, so pool.initialPrice is provenance only.
